column2: CF01 - Identity, Authentication & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Verify JWT login, BCrypt password validation, 6-digit OTP verification, refresh token rotation, and RBAC permission boundaries.

column1: CF01.1 - User Login, JWT Token Rotation & Logout

column2: Login with valid email and password returns JWT Access & Refresh tokens
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password
column4: HTTP 200 OK; returns signed JWT accessToken, refreshToken, role, and regionId

column2: Reject login with invalid password or unregistered email
column4: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with generic invalid credentials message

column2: Rotate Refresh Token for new JWT pair and revoke old Refresh Token
column3:
1. POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with valid refreshToken
2. Replay old refreshToken
column4: First call returns 200 OK; replay of old token returns 401 Unauthorized

column2: Revoke active Refresh Token upon user logout
column4: HTTP 200 OK on logout; subsequent refresh returns 401 Unauthorized

column2: Block login for deactivated or locked user account
column3:
1. Admin deactivates user
2. POST /api/v1/auth/login as deactivated user

column1: CF01.2 - OTP Verification & Password Recovery / Change

column2: Verify valid 6-digit OTP code within 5-minute expiration window
column4: HTTP 200 OK; OTP verified and password reset token issued

column2: Reject invalid or expired 6-digit OTP verification code
column4: HTTP 400 Bad Request; invalid or expired OTP code

column2: Change password with valid complexity (min 8 chars, upper, lower, digit, symbol)
column3: 1. POST /api/v1/auth/change-password with currentPassword and strong newPassword
column4: HTTP 200 OK; BCrypt password hash updated

column2: Reject weak password (<8 chars or missing uppercase/digit)
column4: HTTP 400 Bad Request; password policy violation

column1: CF01.3 - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & User Management

column2: Admin creates new user account and assigns Role (Inspector) & Region
column3:
1. Authenticate as Admin
2. POST /api/v1/users with email, fullName, role=Inspector, regionId
column4: HTTP 201 Created; user created in IdentityDbContext

column2: Admin updates user role and regional scope assignment
column4: HTTP 200 OK; role updated and reflected in subsequent JWT claims

column2: Block unauthenticated request to protected API endpoints
Block non-Admin user (Pilot/Inspector) from accessing Admin User Management API
